construction_kit_filter: Tools, pipelines, systems, materials, environments and props may be carried over. Characters, character names, logos and branding from other productions may not.
settled_rulings_never_relitigated: A pending approval parks only its own run; other work continues.
Creatures speak in cries and sounds only; humans speak words.
Shadows are added at composite time, never baked into character art.
The newest registered version of a piece is the one used for its scene unless a written exception rides the run.
staging_law: Production material stages to GitHub first, TeraBox for what is too large; local disk is a workbench, not a warehouse.
